crossRefs.note: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal. Merib Baal became the father of Micah.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

people.name: Micah
people.line: Son of Mephibosheth, grandson of Jonathan.

translations.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal. Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
translations.bsb: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, who was the father of Micah.
translations.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
translations.asv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
